personality_one_liner: A precision dark-mode trading journal and capital management command center built for high-contrast visibility, strict risk control, and real-time gold market insights.

spacing.rule: Generous touch spacing with compact tactical data cards; sticky primary bottom CTA and clear tabular hierarchy.

do's: Use solid dark graphite surfaces for maximum visibility and zero eye strain
Use amber/gold warm accents for primary metrics and active states
dont's: Avoid transparent blurring over complex charts

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Command center displaying multi-account capital overview, today's P&L, daily challenge target, 2-loss stop rule status, and quick trade entry.

states.loading: Loading account performance and live gold momentum...
states.empty: No trading data recorded for this account yet. Tap 'New Trade' to log your first operation.
states.error: Failed to load account metrics. Please check connection and retry.

screens.layout: Vertical scroll with sticky header switcher for accounts, main capital banner, daily target progress bar, gold market briefing preview card, recent trades list with edit/delete actions, and floating new trade action.

screens.name: TradeJournal
screens.purpose: Comprehensive editable trade log with P&L, notes, filtering, and instant edit/delete capabilities.

states.empty: No trades match the current filter. Add trades to track performance.
states.error: Could not retrieve trade records. Tap to retry.

screens.layout: Search & filter header bar, date grouped trade list items with clear win/loss badge indicators, expandable review notes, and inline edit/delete modals.

screens.name: AiAssistant
screens.purpose: AI trading coach providing gold market briefing (momentum, direction, impulse) and practical discipline advice.

states.loading: Analyzing gold price action and trading psychology...
states.error: Failed to fetch AI market briefing. Retry.

screens.layout: Gold momentum banner card, live XAU/USD key levels grid, AI practical discipline checklist, and interactive prompt assistant.

screens.name: DisciplineJournal
screens.purpose: Dedicated psychological notes, rules checklist, 2-loss rule monitor, and daily improvement reflections.
screens.layout: Rule enforcement cards (e.g. 2-loss stop rule status), personal improvement notes log, and quick reflection recorder.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Manage multiple accounts, switch between currency or percentage target mode, configure notifications, and data backups.
screens.layout: Account selector manager, calculation mode toggle (Amount vs Percentage), risk management threshold inputs, and notification toggles.

gold_chart_hero.alt: Gold candlestick chart and dark terminal background

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a dark-first trading journal app with high-contrast amber/gold typography and icons for users with vision requirements. Support multi-account management, editable and deletable trades, dynamic amount vs percentage goals, a 2-loss stop rule monitor, AI gold market briefing, and discipline notes without intrusive notifications. Ensure robust state management for CRUD operations on trades.
